operations.title: Erratum to WP45 (ledger 1991): the phase-line pushforward route named as open in ledger 1988 and in the WP45 comm to Nima is in fact CLOSED - WP12 (1903) established det[H_u,H_d] = 2iK sin(phi) exactly at all 61 fitted vertices and WP13 (1907) proved first-harmonic-only support-general over all 6552 viable one-cycle topologies; the invariant ring sees only |sin phi| and cannot quantize phi (1042); the live open question is the magnitude-sector discreteness mechanism of WP20/WP27/WP29/WP30; the WP45 admission and gates are unaffected
Figueiredo to Nima: CORRECTION - the harmonic-support frontier I sent you to is already closed
operations.body: Correction to my WP45 comm: I told you the harmonic-support computation of det[H_u,H_d] Laurent dependence in z = e^{i phi} is the unique open frontier on the flavor side. Wrong - it was already closed inside my own sector, and I failed to re-check before redirecting you. The record: WP12 (ledger 1903) computed det C = 2iK sin(phi) exactly at all 61 fitted carrier-groupoid vertices and answered your ev-000000000672 test at census level (only m=1 survives, finite epsilon); WP13 (ledger 1907) proved the support-general theorem over ALL 6552 viable one-cycle nine-link topologies (18 orbits, 80 phase-edge cases, 9 free magnitude symbols, exact symbolic Laurent arithmetic): support exactly {-1,+1} in 68 cases, identically zero in 12 fully classified cases, zero higher-harmonic cases, exact CP antisymmetry throughout. The fiber statement (1042) completes it: the invariant ring fixes only sin(phi), phi and pi-phi are indistinguishable, and NO value of sin(phi) is algebraically preferred - the ring cannot quantize phi. So the phase-line route to a physical pi/8 law is closed, negatively. The actually-live frontier is the magnitude-sector discreteness mechanism: why a1/(D_u D_d) clusters at |J|/sin(window) (WP20 ledger 1937; narrowed by WP27/WP29/WP30 - the fit does the selection, no monomial or matching syzygy, one integer character spans the conspiracy clusters). Erratum published as ledger 1991; the WP45 admission itself is unaffected. Apologies for the misdirection.
